errorBoundary.title: This view ran into a problem
errorBoundary.body: The error has been logged. The rest of ReadAware keeps working — you can try again.

errors.pluginNetworkRateLimited: The network request or transfer limit was reached. Try again in a minute.
errors.pluginNetworkFailed: The network request failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.pluginHttpAuth: The server denied access. Check the address and access requirements.
errors.pluginHttpNotFound: The requested address was not found or is no longer available.
errors.pluginHttpRateLimited: The server is receiving too many requests. Try again later.
errors.pluginHttpServer: The server could not complete the request. Try again later.
errors.pluginHttpRejected: The server rejected the request. Check the address and request details.
errors.aiRequestTimeout: This AI request timed out. The provider may still have processed it.
errors.aiBusy: Plugin AI requests are busy. Wait for one to finish.
errors.aiInvalidInteraction: This form request is invalid. Ask the assistant to try again.
errors.pluginInvalidArgument: This plugin request contains invalid parameters.
errors.pluginQuotaExceeded: This plugin request exceeds the data limit. Use a smaller batch.
errors.settingsOptionsInvalid: This setting option query is invalid.
errors.settingsOptionsForbidden: This plugin is not allowed to list options for that setting.
errors.settingsForbidden: This plugin is not allowed to access that setting.
errors.settingsOptionsStale: The setting options have changed. Start the search again.
errors.settingsOptionsUnavailable: The plugin's setting options are unavailable. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.settingsFontEnumerationFailed: Installed fonts could not be listed.
errors.pluginNetworkBusy: This plugin has too many network requests in progress. Wait for one to finish.
errors.pluginNetworkClosed: This network response is closed, expired, or unavailable.
errors.pluginNetworkReadInvalid: The plugin requested an invalid network read.
errors.pluginNetworkTimeout: This network request exceeded its time limit.
errors.pluginNetworkBodyTooLarge: This network request or response exceeds the size limit.
errors.pluginNetworkDenied: This plugin is not authorized to contact that destination.
errors.pluginNetworkRedirect: This network request encountered a disallowed or invalid redirect.
errors.capabilityQueryInvalid: Check the capability catalog filters and page limits.
errors.capabilityCatalogChanged: The capability catalog changed. Start again from the first page.
errors.capabilityCatalogUnavailable: The capability catalog could not be displayed within its size limit.
errors.bookRangeInvalid: The text range or its read bounds are invalid.
errors.bookRangeMissing: This passage no longer resolves. Search for it again.
errors.bookRangeAmbiguous: This passage matches more than one location. Search for a more specific match.
errors.bookRangeUnsupported: This content does not support reading text ranges.
errors.bookRangeForbidden: This passage is beyond the permitted reading boundary.
errors.annotationObserverLimit: Too many annotation subscriptions are active.
errors.memoryForgottenSuppressed: The reader previously forgot this memory. Automatic extraction did not recreate it.
errors.memoryInputBudgetExceeded: Memory input is too large for this operation.
errors.memoryOutputBudgetExceeded: Memory generation exceeded its output limit.
errors.annotationReadBudgetExceeded: This annotation read is too large. Use pages for collections; shorten an oversized note in the reader before retrying.
errors.annotationObservationFailed: Annotations could not be refreshed. Try again.
errors.memoryTaskNotFound: This graph task is no longer available. Start a new task.
errors.memoryTaskLimit: Too many graph requests are active. Wait for a request to finish.
errors.memoryObserverLimit: Too many memory subscriptions are active.
errors.memoryObservationFailed: Memory could not be read. Try again.
errors.memoryNotFound: This memory is no longer available.
errors.memoryConflict: This memory changed. Refresh it before editing.
errors.memoryUnavailable: Memory management requires the desktop app.
errors.memoryForbidden: This memory is outside the allowed scope.
errors.memoryInvalidQuery: Choose valid memory scopes, names, or a chapter number.
errors.settingsObserverLimit: Too many settings subscriptions are active.
errors.backupInvalidArchive: This file is not a supported, complete ReadAware backup.
errors.backupUnlockFailed: The backup could not be unlocked. Check the password and the file’s integrity.
errors.backupPasswordPolicy: Use a backup password with at least 12 characters and no more than 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
errors.backupLegacyFormat: This is a retired library backup (.json) and can no longer be restored. Choose a complete encrypted backup (.age) instead.
errors.dataWipeIncomplete: Local records were deleted, but some files could not be removed. Reload to finish cleanup before continuing.
errors.backupRecoveryRequired: Restore could not finish rolling back its files. Restart ReadAware to recover before continuing.
errors.backupIncomplete: Some files needed for a complete backup are missing or unsupported. Restore the missing files before trying again.
errors.backupBusy: Another backup operation is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
errors.backupChanged: Data changed or failed verification while preparing the backup. Try again after current operations finish.
errors.pluginRecoveryRequired: The plugin update could not be restored safely. Its data is temporarily unavailable.
errors.pluginInvalidPackage: This isn't a valid plugin package.
errors.pluginBuiltIn: Built-in plugins ship with ReadAware and can't be replaced or removed.
errors.pluginCandidateStale: This plugin install is out of date. Start the install again.
errors.pluginNoPreviousVersion: No earlier version of this plugin is available to restore.
errors.pluginUpdateRequired: This version of the plugin was made for an older ReadAware. Update the plugin to use it.
errors.pluginAppUpdateRequired: This plugin needs a newer version of ReadAware. Update ReadAware to use it.
errors.pluginObjectAccessStateInvalid: This plugin's book access setting couldn't be read. Choose its book access again.
errors.updateUnavailable: Software updates aren't available for this installation.
errors.updateNotReady: No update is ready to install. Check for updates first.
errors.updateNetwork: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.updateInvalidRelease: The update failed verification and wasn't installed.
errors.updateInstallFailed: The update couldn't be installed. Download it from the ReadAware website instead.
errors.exportTargetInvalid: This export's save location is no longer valid. Export again and choose where to save it.
errors.pluginDataBusy: This plugin is being updated. Try saving again when the update finishes.
errors.pluginObjectAccessDenied: This book is outside the plugin’s access. Review its book access in plugin settings.
errors.pluginSettingsStale: This plugin has changed. Close and reopen its settings before saving.
errors.settingsUnavailable: Settings could not be read. Try again.
errors.workspaceInvalid: The navigation target or selection is invalid.
errors.workspaceMissing: That page, collection, or selection is no longer available.
errors.workspaceChanged: The workspace changed. Check its current state before trying again.
errors.workspaceUnavailable: The workspace is not ready yet.
errors.workspaceTimeout: The destination did not finish opening.
errors.workspaceReadingPermission: Leaving the reader requires reading-control permission.
errors.workspaceObserverLimit: Too many workspace subscriptions are active.
errors.readingTimeInvalid: Check the book, calendar day and session page limits.
errors.readingTimeStale: Reading statistics are still recovering. Try again when recovery finishes.
errors.readingTimeUnavailable: Reading time could not be loaded.
errors.readingTimeLimit: Close another live reading-time view before opening this one.
errors.bookRemovalCleanupPending: The books were removed, but local file cleanup did not finish.
errors.bookRemovalReappeared: A book is present again. Its files were not released.
errors.bookCleanupInvalid: The file cleanup query is invalid.
errors.bookCleanupStale: The library is still recovering. Try file cleanup again after recovery finishes.
errors.bookSearchCancelled: The book text search was cancelled.
errors.bookSearchInvalid: Check the search queries and limits, then try again.
errors.bookNotFound: This book is no longer in the library.
errors.pluginActionDisabled: This plugin action is not currently available.
errors.bookTextExtractionFailed: Some book text could not be prepared. Try again to resume unfinished sections.
errors.bookTextUnsupported: This book does not provide supported text sections for chapter indexing.
errors.bookTextTimeout: Text preparation reached its time limit. Saved checkpoints remain; start a new request to continue.
errors.bookTextCancelled: This text preparation request was cancelled.
errors.bookTextBusy: Text preparation is already running. Wait for it to finish before rebuilding.
errors.bookTextTaskNotFound: This text request is no longer available to this caller.
errors.bookTextTaskLimit: Too many text requests or observers are active. Finish or cancel existing requests first.
errors.settingsInvalidShortcut: Choose a valid key and optional modifiers. Escape is reserved for closing overlays.
errors.settingsShortcutConflict: That shortcut is already assigned. Choose another combination or update the conflicting bindings together.
errors.readerPlaybackFailed: Read aloud stopped because audio could not be played. Try again or choose another voice.
errors.readerSegmentationFailed: The reading mode could not prepare this passage. Turn the mode off and on to try again.
errors.annotationConflict: This annotation changed. Read it again before applying your changes.
errors.annotationUnavailable: Annotation storage is not available in this environment.
errors.annotationCancelled: The annotation change was cancelled before it was submitted.
errors.annotationNotFound: This annotation no longer exists or is a different type.
errors.annotationInvalidInput: The annotation request contains an invalid value.
errors.annotationForbidden: Only the reading assistant can record a question trace.
errors.bookEncryption: This book is encrypted or DRM-protected and cannot be opened. Use an unprotected copy.
errors.bookUnsupportedFormat: This book format is not supported.
errors.bookParseFailed: This file could not be parsed. Try another copy.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Details are in the app log.
errors.fsNotFound: A file ReadAware needs is missing.
errors.fsPermission: ReadAware doesn't have permission to access a needed file.
errors.fsNoSpace: The disk is full. Free up space and try again.
errors.dbLocked: The local database is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.dbError: The local database ran into a problem.
errors.secretsUnavailable: The credential store can't be opened, so keys can't be saved or read.
errors.aiNotConfigured: AI isn't set up yet — add an API key to start chatting.
errors.aiMemoryDisabled: Building memory is disabled. You can enable it in AI settings.
errors.aiContextChanged: Reading privacy settings changed, so this request was stopped. Try again with the current settings.
errors.aiContextWithheld: This action needs reading text that your privacy settings withhold. Review AI privacy settings to continue.
errors.aiInvalidReadingContext: This action supplied invalid reading context. Update the app or plugin before trying again.
errors.aiAuth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
errors.aiRateLimited: The AI provider is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.aiQuota: Your AI account is out of credit or quota. Check your provider account.
errors.aiNetwork: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your connection and try again.
errors.aiProvider: The AI provider had a temporary problem. Try again shortly.
errors.aiContextOverflow: This request is too large for the model.
errors.aiUnknown: The AI request failed. Details are in the app log.
errors.syncNetwork: Can't reach the sync server. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncServer: The sync server is temporarily unavailable. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncRateLimited: Syncing is being rate-limited. It will retry automatically.
errors.syncUnauthorized: Your sync session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.syncMisdirected: The sync server address answered as a different service. Check the relay URL.
errors.syncPassphrase: The end-to-end encryption passphrase doesn't match.
errors.syncTransportUnavailable: The plugin providing this sync connection isn't available. Enable the plugin, then try again.
errors.syncTransportMismatch: The sync plugin's server settings changed after connecting. Reconnect to adopt the new server.
errors.syncLogIncomplete: This device is still filling in the account's history from the server. Try again once sync has caught up.
errors.syncCheckpointMismatch: The account snapshot was made by a different version of ReadAware and was ignored. Sync will rebuild from the full history instead.
errors.syncCheckpointPrecondition: A checkpoint could not be saved right now because some changes are still waiting to sync. It will be retried automatically.
errors.localSaveFailed: This change couldn't be written to local storage and may be lost after a restart.
errors.pluginAssetConflict: This saved asset changed or was deleted. Refresh the list before continuing.
errors.aiImageUnsupported: Choose a model that supports image inputs.
errors.aiImageInvalid: This image cannot be used as an AI input.
errors.aiImageBudget: The image input limit was reached. Use fewer or smaller images.
errors.bookContentBudget: This section exceeds the content query limit.
errors.aiOutputBudget: The AI output limit was reached. Reduce the request or increase its budget.
errors.aiInputBudget: The AI request contains too much text. Use a smaller selection.
errors.pluginServiceUnavailable: This plugin service changed or stopped. Refresh its list before continuing.
errors.pluginServiceForbidden: This service call exceeds the plugins’ shared permissions or book access.
errors.pluginServiceCycle: This service call would repeat an existing call chain and was stopped.
errors.pluginServiceTimeout: The service exceeded its time limit. Check the result before retrying any changes.
errors.pluginServiceResultInvalid: The service returned an invalid result. Check the outcome before retrying.
errors.pluginServiceFailed: The plugin service failed. Check the outcome before repeating changes.
errors.pluginServiceDataChanged: The service’s document changed. Read it again before saving.
errors.changesExpired: Saved changes have expired or data was restored. Reload current data before continuing.
errors.changesScopeChanged: The saved position belongs to a different query or access scope. Start again for the current scope.
errors.changesInvalid: This change query is invalid or unsupported. Check its areas and readable settings paths.
errors.jobsUnstableSource: This event cannot start a saved task. Its plugin subscriptions need stable rule identifiers.
errors.changesUnavailable: Saved changes are available in the desktop app.
errors.transactionConflict: The data or available options changed. Prepare a new preview.
errors.transactionInvalid: This operation cannot be included in the transaction.
errors.transactionPreviewExpired: The preview expired. Prepare a new preview before submitting.
errors.transactionReceiptMissing: No transaction receipt was found for this caller.
errors.transactionQuota: The transaction limit was reached. Reduce the batch or pending previews.
errors.transactionNoChanges: The requested state is already present.
errors.searchNotConfigured: Enable Search and add its API key in Settings → AI.
errors.searchAuth: The search provider rejected the key. Check the search key in Settings → AI.
errors.searchAccess: This account cannot access the requested search API. Check your provider account.
errors.searchRateLimited: The search request limit was reached. Wait and try again.
errors.searchNetwork: Could not reach the search provider. Check your connection.
errors.searchTimeout: Web retrieval timed out. Try again.
errors.searchInvalidInput: Use a valid query or public web URL.
errors.searchProvider: The search provider returned an unexpected response.
errors.searchFetchFailed: This page could not be read. It may require login or block automated access.
errors.searchTooLarge: This page is too large to read. Try a smaller source.
errors.localApiBind: The Local API port is in use. Close the other service using this port, then start the API again.
errors.localApiUnavailable: Local API is not ready. Keep ReadAware open and try again.
errors.bookFolderTooLarge: This folder holds more than 5,000 books. Choose a smaller folder and import it in parts.
errors.fontInvalid: This file is not a supported font (TTF, OTF, TTC, WOFF or WOFF2).
errors.fontTooLarge: This font file is too large (the limit is 128 MB).
errors.fontCleanupStale: Fonts are still being restored — try again shortly.

crashPrompt.title: ReadAware had a problem last time
crashPrompt.body: Sending a diagnostics report helps get it fixed.

pluginServices.approvalNote: Approve these permissions for this call only. Book access includes the full book and may include unread material; global access includes all books. Changes and external effects may not be undoable.

community.title: Help ReadAware grow
community.description: A GitHub star helps more readers discover ReadAware. Join us on Discord to share ideas and shape what comes next.
